name: get_project_agent_recovery_inventory
purpose: Read sanitized, bounded pages of project agent runs or checkpoint pending-write format metadata without exposing context or authorizing recovery.
useWhen: Compatibility review before a checkpoint recovery release
avoidWhen: Resuming, migrating, deleting or approving runs

inputs.source: Previous page nextCursor from the same project, workspace, mode and run
inputs.notes: Opaque; omit for the first page. Maximum 3072 characters.
Integer 1..50, default 25; at most limit+1 rows plus one parent run in checkpoint mode.
Requires project manage access, even though the tool is read-only.

inputs.source: items[].id from this tool in runs mode
inputs.notes: Omit to page runs; supply to page that run's checkpoints.

preconditions: Existing API-key credential permits this tool
Caller can manage the project; run and checkpoint scopes are checked
returns: {projectId,workspaceId,runId,mode,readOnly:true,authorizesResume:false,coverage,snapshotConsistent:false,generatedAt,items,pageCount,hasMore,nextCursor}; items contain IDs, closed-enum classifications, timestamps and counts only.

errors.fix: Use the original cursor for the same scope and integer limit 1..50; do not add mutation fields.

errors.when: Recovery inventory scope mismatch or run unavailable
errors.fix: Stop and report incomplete; do not bypass scope checks or query production storage directly.

errors.when: You do not have permission to manage this project
errors.fix: Stop and ask the owner to arrange the appropriate access; do not create credentials.

gotchas.text: No raw context, prompts, task IDs, channels or pending-write values in the response
No orphan coverage or atomic snapshot; complete every applicable cursor or report incomplete
Legacy/unattributed, invalid, missing or unknown version requires explicit review; partial records are not resumable

name: replace_aish_delivery_session
purpose: Record an immutable owner-approved substitution of a failed delivery session by an equivalent completed successor, preserving all history.
useWhen: The owner explicitly approved the exact source/successor pair and its resolved governance decision
avoidWhen: Creating jobs, retrying, changing budgets or waiving requirements
No owner decision or incomplete successor evidence

inputs.source: Owner-resolved governance clarification naming both sessions
inputs.notes: Required; decision remains bound and revalidated

inputs.source: true for preview; false only after verified preview
inputs.notes: Defaults true; preview does not mutate

inputs.source: fingerprint from the immediately preceding dry-run

inputs.notes: Completed and independently passing technical DoD

preconditions: Workspace owner credential and explicit owner order
Resolved owner clarification identifies both sessions
Same complete non-deployment plan criteria; no active job/checkpoint/coordinator lease
returns: {dryRun:true,fingerprint,replacement,failures:[]} preview; {dryRun:false,replacement,reused} commit; existing receipt on identical retry is not current DoD acceptance.

errors.when: Replacement requires the current dry-run fingerprint.
errors.fix: Read state and preview again; never guess a fingerprint.
Stop and report the failing criteria; do not erase sessions, loosen tests, or create jobs.

errors.when: Only the workspace owner may replace a delivery session.
errors.fix: Stop; request execution using the owner's existing authorized access, never broaden credentials.

gotchas.text: Preserves failed status, jobs and receipts; does not close the activity or waive independent human review.
